description.zh: 所属连接器 ID，请到[百炼控制台](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/cn-beijing/?tab=app#/connector/list)获取
description.en: The ID of the connector. You can find this ID in the [Model Studio console](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/cn-beijing/?tab=app#/connector/list).

description.zh: 查询的连接器名称，精确查询
description.en: The name of the connector to query. An exact match is required.

description.zh: 文件所属的业务空间 ID，获取方式请参见[如何使用业务空间](~~2587495~~)
description.en: The ID of the business space. To obtain this ID, see [Use business spaces](~~2587495~~).

descriptions.zh:
- RAM用户（子账号）需要首先获取阿里云百炼的[API权限](~~2848578~~)（需要`AliyunBailianDataFullAccess`，已包括sfm:GetConnector权限点），并[加入一个业务空间](~~2851098~~)后，方可调用本接口。阿里云账号（主账号）可直接调用无须授权。建议您通过最新版[阿里云百炼SDK](https://api.aliyun.com/api-tools/sdk/bailian?version=2023-12-29)[阿里云百炼SDK](https://api.alibabacloud.com/api-tools/sdk/bailian?version=2023-12-29)来调用本接口。
- 本接口具备幂等性。

**限流说明：**
本接口频繁调用会被限流，频率请勿超过5次/秒。如遇限流，请稍后重试。
descriptions.en:
- To call this operation, a RAM user (sub-account) must have the required [API permissions](~~2848578~~) for Alibaba Cloud Model Studio and must [join a business space](~~2851098~~). This requires the `AliyunBailianDataFullAccess` policy, which includes the sfm:GetConnector permission. An Alibaba Cloud account (primary account) can call this operation directly. We recommend using the latest [Alibaba Cloud Model Studio SDK](https://api.aliyun.com/api-tools/sdk/bailian?version=2023-12-29)[Alibaba Cloud Model Studio SDK](https://api.alibabacloud.com/api-tools/sdk/bailian?version=2023-12-29) to call this operation.

- This operation is idempotent.

**Throttling:**
This operation is subject to throttling. Do not exceed a frequency of 5 calls per second. If a request is throttled, try again later.
